overview: An NFT minting studio where creators mint, price, claim and sell NFTs with verified ICP payments.
features: Mint NFTs with media, name, description, creator and collection details
Set, update and clear a whole-value USD price to list or unlist an NFT
Generate free claim links with per-drop supply limits and duplicate-claim prevention
Buy NFTs with ICP, verified against the ledger before ownership transfers
Replay-protected, idempotent purchase settlement that prevents double sales
Recover a pending purchase without paying twice
One consistent purchase flow from the marketplace, public NFT pages and landing page
A Library that reflects true ownership with no duplicates
